name: deep-search
author: octos
description: Deep multi-round web research: free sources first (GDELT, Google News RSS, optional SearXNG, then keyed APIs), polite page reading (robots.txt, identifiable User-Agent, browser for JS-heavy pages), reference chasing, a cited report and structured items.

tools.name: search
tools.description:
Single-binary research pipeline (one synthesis model, fixed flow): searches a focused topic from multiple angles, fetches pages in parallel, chases references, and writes one structured report.

WHEN TO USE: focused single-topic lookups where one report suffices and you don't need parallel sub-queries or per-node model control.

WHEN TO USE `run_pipeline` INSTEAD (PREFERRED for 深度研究 / deep research / comprehensive analysis): the user asks for multi-perspective research, comparative analysis across topics, or any query phrased as 深度研究/深入调研/深度分析/comprehensive/thorough — write an inline DOT graph with `run_pipeline` so each perspective gets its own search node (run in parallel), its own analysis node, and a final synthesis node. This gives you parallel fan-out, per-node model selection (cheap models for search, strong models for synthesis), and a much richer output than this single-binary tool.

Controls: lang (one or many), region, since, max_per_domain, domains_allow/deny. output=items returns structured items (title, url, source, lang, published date, summary, citation). News works without any API key. Report file path is printed at end of output.

query.description: The research topic or question to investigate

depth.description: Research depth: 1=quick (single search + crawl, ~1min), 2=standard (3 search rounds + reference chasing, ~3min), 3=thorough (5 search rounds + aggressive link chasing, ~5min). Default: 2

max_results.description: Number of search results per round (1-10, default: 8)

search_engine.description: Try one provider first: gdelt, google_news_rss, searxng, serper, tavily, perplexity, brave, you; or all. Default: automatic order (free sources first: GDELT + Google News for news, then SearXNG if configured, then keyed APIs). Search-results page scraping (duckduckgo, bing_cdp) is off unless the operator enables it. Falls back to the automatic order if it returns nothing.

output.description: report (default): Markdown report. items: structured JSON items (url, title, source, lang, published, summary, citation) instead; the report and <slug>_report.items.json are written either way.

lang.description: BCP-47 language(s) to search in and keep, e.g. "en" or ["en", "zh-CN", "es"]. Each language gets its own queries. Unknown-language results are kept.

region.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 region, e.g. US or TW (Google News edition, Brave/Serper country).

since.description: Only results published since an ISO date (2026-09-01) or a span: 24h, 7d, 2w, 3m, 1y. Applied via provider date filters and page/feed dates; undated results are kept.

category.description: news enables the GDELT + Google News free tier; auto (default) = news when since <= 31 days or the query mentions news/latest/today.

max_per_domain.description: At most this many sources per domain.

render.description: auto (default): render JS-heavy pages in a headless browser when plain HTTP returns no main text. off: plain HTTP only.

synthesis_config.description: Synthesis LLM provider config injected by the host. When all four fields are populated, takes precedence over the legacy DEEPSEEK_API_KEY/etc env-var path. Operators should not set this directly — the host populates it from the agent's configured provider.

api_key.description: Bearer token for the synthesis provider. Never logged.

model.description: Model id to request (e.g. deepseek-chat). Overridable via DEEP_SEARCH_SYNTHESIS_MODEL env.

provider.description: Provider label used by the v2 cost envelope (e.g. deepseek).
